paper_id: Gao et al. - 2022 - Trinity High-Performance Mobile Emulation through Graphics Projection
title: Trinity: High-Performance Mobile Emulation through Graphics Projection
motivation: 现有移动模拟器在图形密集型应用上效率和兼容性均差，无法流畅运行重型3D游戏
problem_framing: 如何解耦guest-host控制流和数据流，使GPU复用时的VM Exit最小化
key_insight: 图形操作是handle-based的，Type-1和Type-2调用仅与主存中的轻量句柄交互
method_signature: 在guest内存中创建投影空间维护shadow contexts和资源句柄，配合流控和数据遥传
evaluation_criteria: 93.3%原生性能，97.2%应用兼容性，相比其他模拟器提升1.4×至20×
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 仅测量Android+OpenGL ES，需手动移植Linux系统调用；static timing analysis仍有4%偏差
evidence_for_taste: cannot smoothly run many common apps
This stems from a common GPU's internal design
can easily lead to control flow oscillation
thinking_moves: 从handle机制的本质出发，将昂贵的同步调用转化为异步执行
借鉴网络MIMD拥塞控制原理解决guest-host执行速度不匹配
将数据交付过程分解为聚合-持久化-到达通知三阶段以匹配动态情况
